omitted_kind.baseline_difference: gbb 0.3.3 sets kind=grok when --kind is omitted (bin/gbb cmd_launch). bac does not. dots-tunnel-bridge gbb_launch defaults the Python argument to codex and then passes --kind explicitly; bac_launch must require the caller to choose.

kinds.evidence: case "$kind" in grok | codex) is the only accept branch. Codex screen classification (hooks_review, question, dialog, fresh, ready) runs only when kind is codex. A model footer may be recorded as an observation; it is not a default.
Same accept branch. ADR 0005: when Grok reports status, bac must not guess from the screen. No model footer parser exists.
No pi branch in bin/gbb at the baseline. Launch and handover of a reported pi agent are errors. A migrated row keeps the pane and owner and stores kind null with kind_reported pi.
No antigravity branch in bin/gbb at the baseline. Same rejection as pi.

extensible.rule: A later contract version may add a kind only by listing it here with support supported or rejected. An unlisted kind is kind_unsupported with kind_support unknown. It is never rewritten to codex or grok.
extensible.model_metadata: model id is a separate object with provenance observed, config, or unknown. Kind does not imply a model.
